stories.story_fr: L'équipe de CF Industries a continué à délivrer une performance opérationnelle sûre et exceptionnelle au premier trimestre 2026, malgré une forte demande mondiale d'azote et une offre tendue.
stories.story_en: The CF Industries team continued to deliver safely outstanding operational performance in the first quarter of 2026 against a backdrop of strong global nitrogen demand and tight global nitrogen supply.
stories.quote: The CF Industries team continued to deliver safely outstanding operational performance in the first quarter of 2026 against a backdrop of strong global nitrogen demand and tight global nitrogen supply as we entered the year.

stories.story_fr: Le résultat net du premier trimestre 2026 reflète un gain d'environ 170 M$ provenant d'un règlement de litige.
stories.story_en: First quarter 2026 net earnings reflect a gain of approximately $170 million from a litigation settlement.
stories.quote: First quarter 2026 net earnings (1) of $615 million, or $3.98 per diluted share, EBITDA (2) of $1.01 billion, and adjusted EBITDA (2) of $983 million. First quarter 2026 financial results reflect a gain of approximately $170 million from a litigation settlement.

stories.story_fr: CF Industries a racheté 16,6 M d'actions pour 1,34 M$ en 2025, réduisant ainsi le nombre d'actions en circulation d'environ 10 %.
stories.story_en: CF Industries repurchased 16.6 million shares for $1.34 billion during 2025, reducing the outstanding share count by approximately 10% compared to the end of 2024.
stories.quote: Repurchased 16.6 million shares for $1.34 billion during 2025, reducing the Company’s outstanding share count by approximately 10% compared to the end of 2024.

stories.story_fr: Le taux d'incidents enregistrable sur 200 000 heures de travail a augmenté à 0,26 en 2025, indiquant une détérioration de la sécurité.
stories.story_en: The Company’s full year 2025 recordable incident rate was 0.26 incidents per 200,000 work hours.
stories.quote: The Company’s full year 2025 recordable incident rate was 0.26 incidents per 200,000 work hours.
